svg.title: System architecture of the Bitcoin Address Activity Explorer
svg.desc: Browser (React views, charts, hooks, Axios client), the Vite dev proxy, the FastAPI service (middleware, routers, services, one error module), Assignment 2's frozen runtime, local files, and the optional parts.
